content.text:
The Growth team signs off on this now. Post the change in **#growth-eng**, and any Growth engineer can approve it.

This comes from the team's shared notes; I didn't find a CODEOWNERS file in the repo. The notes say the notifier moved to Growth on 2026-09-01. An older note said Dana Okafor had to approve template and copy changes, but that's out of date because Dana moved to Platform. I've marked that old note as superseded.

When you edit the wording, the receipt template lives in `services/notifier/templates/` as an `.mjml` file. It has a plain-text twin (`.txt`) with the same variables, and you need to update both. Some corporate mail gateways strip HTML, so those readers only see the text version.
